groups.name: feature
groups.title: Structure of each screen
groups.summary: A module per screen. Each :feature:<name> holds one Screen / ViewModel / Route, and grows with screen parts and tests

groups.name: ui
groups.title: UI (shared layer)
groups.summary: UI shared across features: the four packages of :ui, and :navigation

groups.name: data
groups.title: Data layer
groups.summary: What :data holds: fetching and storing data

groups.name: app
groups.title: Entrypoint layer
groups.summary: What :app holds: the launch entrypoints and the Android resources

groups.name: testing
groups.title: Testing
groups.summary: What exists to verify the app: shared fakes, tests, the architecture definition, generated docs, the layout snapshot and the baseline

groups.name: Gradle
groups.title: Gradle
groups.summary: The files that make this project a Gradle build

groups.name: GradleWrapper
groups.title: Gradle wrapper
groups.summary: What runs the build with the Gradle version the project pins

groups.name: tool
groups.title: Tools
groups.summary: Tools the repository carries that are neither the app nor the build

roles.name: Screen
roles.title: Screen
roles.summary: A @Composable that implements the UI of one screen. One <Name>Screen.kt per :feature:<name>

roles.name: ViewModel
roles.title: ViewModel
roles.summary: An androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel that exposes screen state as a StateFlow and receives events

constraints.name: Must not import Compose or Android (ktFileContent)

roles.name: Route
roles.title: Route
roles.summary: The destination of a screen. The only entrance a feature exposes to the outside

roles.name: FeatureComponent
roles.title: Screen part
roles.summary: A @Composable used by only one screen. Placed as <Name>*.kt in the component package of :feature:<name>

roles.name: FeatureTest
roles.title: Screen test
roles.summary: A test in src/test of :feature:<name> that runs the ViewModel with fakes from :testing

layout.description: For `:feature:home`. Start the file name with `Home`
For `:feature:settings`. Start the file name with `Settings`

roles.name: Component
roles.title: Shared component
roles.summary: A part in the component package of the :ui module, used across features

roles.name: Theme
roles.title: Theme
roles.summary: Colors, typography and shapes, kept in the theme package of the :ui module

roles.name: UiCore
roles.title: UI foundation
roles.summary: Types that form the foundation of the UI layer, kept in the core package of the :ui module

roles.name: PreviewRoot
roles.title: Preview base
roles.summary: The base every @Preview wraps its body in, kept in the preview package of :ui. Decides the theme and background in one place, and takes darkTheme to show light and dark

roles.name: Navigation
roles.title: Screen navigation
roles.summary: Movement between screens, kept in :navigation

roles.name: RepositoryInterface
roles.title: Repository interface
roles.summary: The interface for fetching and storing data, in :data, in one package per subject (user / settings)

roles.name: RepositoryImplementation
roles.title: Repository implementation
roles.summary: The implementation of a repository interface, in :data, next to the interface

roles.name: ActivityEntrypoint
roles.title: Activity entrypoint
roles.summary: The single Activity Android launches, kept in :app

roles.name: ApplicationEntrypoint
roles.title: Application entrypoint
roles.summary: The single Application class Android creates at process start, kept in :app

roles.name: AndroidManifest
roles.title: Android manifest
roles.summary: AndroidManifest.xml of :app, which declares the app to Android

roles.name: ProguardRules
roles.title: Proguard rules
roles.summary: proguard-rules.pro of :app, the rules the code shrinker reads

roles.name: AndroidResource
roles.title: Android resources
roles.summary: The res/ tree of :app, whose inner structure the Android resource system decides

roles.name: Fake
roles.title: Fake
roles.summary: A stand-in implementation kept in :testing, used by the tests of other modules

roles.name: ProjectArchitectureTest
roles.title: Architecture test
roles.summary: The single JUnit test that runs the definition, kept in src/test/kotlin of :architecture-test

roles.name: ProjectArchitectureSpec
roles.title: Architecture spec
roles.summary: Tests that verify the definition and katachi itself, kept in src/test/kotlin of :architecture-test

roles.name: DefinitionEntry
roles.title: Definition entrypoint
roles.summary: ProjectArchitecture.kt, which only calls the group functions and belongs to no layer

roles.name: DefinitionSections
roles.title: Definition sections
roles.summary: DocumentSections.kt, the section headings every group and role writes through

roles.name: GroupDefinition
roles.title: Group definition
roles.summary: groups/<Name>Group.kt, one group of the definition, which lists its roles by calling their functions

roles.name: RoleDefinition
roles.title: Role definition
roles.summary: roles/<Name>Role.kt, one role of the definition, with where its files live

roles.name: GeneratedDocumentation
roles.title: Generated documentation
roles.summary: Markdown written out from this definition and committed to the repository

roles.name: LayoutSnapshot
roles.title: Layout snapshot
roles.summary: A record of every line of this definition once flattened, so people can review changes to the definition as a diff

roles.name: BaselineFile
roles.title: baseline (ledger of held-back violations)
roles.summary: A ledger of the violations that already existed when katachi was adopted, held back so the test does not fail

roles.name: SettingsScript
roles.summary: Which modules make up the build

roles.name: BuildScript
roles.summary: How one module is built, one per module

constraints.name: namespace of a library module follows the module path

roles.name: GradleProperties
roles.summary: Properties of the build and of the Gradle daemon

roles.name: VersionCatalog
roles.summary: The versions of the build's dependencies and plugins

roles.name: DaemonJvmProperties
roles.summary: Which JVM the Gradle daemon runs on (Gradle 8.8 and later)

roles.name: LauncherScript
roles.summary: The scripts that start the wrapper, for Unix and Windows

roles.name: WrapperJar
roles.summary: The wrapper itself, which downloads and runs Gradle

roles.name: WrapperProperties
roles.summary: Which Gradle distribution the wrapper runs

roles.name: Git
roles.title: Git
roles.summary: .gitignore and the like

roles.name: Documentation
roles.title: Documentation
roles.summary: Explanations for people reading the repository, such as README.md
